<script>
  (function () {
    if (!window.ttq || typeof ttq.instance !== 'function') return;

    /* ---------- Identify (only when present) ---------- */
    var email      = {{js - TikTok Email (cleaned)}};
    var phone      = {{js - TikTok Phone (E164)}};
    var externalId = {{dlv - Thank You Page - Customer ID}};
    var idPayload  = {};

    if (externalId != null && externalId !== '') idPayload.external_id  = String(externalId);
    if (email) idPayload.email = email;            // already cleaned
    if (phone) idPayload.phone_number = phone;     // E.164
    if (Object.keys(idPayload).length) ttq.identify(idPayload);

    /* ---------- Value (use cleaned helper; force numeric) ---------- */
    var value = Number({{js - TikTok Purchase Value (cleaned)}});
    if (!isFinite(value)) value = 0;

    /* ---------- Contents (sanitize / coerce numbers) ---------- */
    var raw = {{js - TikTok Purchase Contents}} || [];
    var contents = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw.map(function (i) {
      var o = {};
      if (i && typeof i === 'object') {
        if (i.content_id != null)  o.content_id = String(i.content_id);
        if (i.content_type)        o.content_type = String(i.content_type);
        if (i.content_name)        o.content_name = String(i.content_name);
        if (i.brand)               o.brand = String(i.brand);
        if (i.content_category)    o.content_category = String(i.content_category);
        if (i.price != null)       o.price = Number(i.price);
        if (i.quantity != null)    o.quantity = Number(i.quantity);
      }
      return o;
    }) : [];

    /* ---------- Track Purchase (must match server exactly) ---------- */
    var orderId = {{dlv - Thank You Page - Order ID}};   // dedupe key
    var opts = {};
    if (orderId != null && orderId !== '') opts.event_id = String(orderId);

    ttq.instance('{{TikTok - Pixel ID}}').track('Purchase', {
      contents: contents,
      currency: '{{dlv - Global - Currency Code}}',
      value: value
    }, opts);
  })();
</script>
